column1: # The site's own words in Serbian (Latin) (README.md here): English as in the code, Serbian (Latin). A text without a row is shown in English.
{0}: hits up to {1} stopped, the rest ×{2}
No match is being played now.
column2: Trenutno se ne igra nijedan meč.

column1: No battle has been fought yet. Be the first.
column2: Još nije odigrana nijedna borba. Budite prvi.

column1: Unofficial community server. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Vostok Games. Survarium is a trademark of its owners. An early test: accounts and progress can be reset at any time.
column2: Nezvanični server zajednice. Nije povezan sa kompanijom Vostok Games niti ga ona podržava. Survarium je zaštitni znak svojih vlasnika. Rano testiranje: nalozi i napredak mogu biti resetovani u bilo kom trenutku.

column1: Too many wrong tokens; wait a minute.
New accounts are refused; existing players sign in as before.
column2: Novi nalozi se ne primaju; postojeći igrači se prijavljuju kao i ranije.

column1: Minutes: a whole number from 1 to {MAX_MAINTENANCE_MINUTES}.
Maintenance starts in {minutes} min, at {0} UTC.
column2: Održavanje počinje za {minutes} min, u {0} UTC.

column1: No such user or address. A name several accounts share needs the user name they sign in with.
column2: Nema takvog korisnika ni adrese. Za ime koje deli više naloga unesite korisničko ime kojim se prijavljuje.

column1: Its address {net} too ({more} more session(s) ended).
Its address is not known, so no address was banned.
column2: Njegova adresa nije poznata, pa nijedna adresa nije blokirana.

column1: {net} was not banned (a range is lifted as it was banned).
column2: {net} nije bila blokirana (opseg se skida onakav kakav je blokiran).

column1: Changes are tried here before they reach the players: it can restart at any moment, and accounts and progress here can be reset.
column2: Ovde se isprobavaju izmene pre nego što stignu do igrača: server može da se restartuje u bilo kom trenutku, a nalozi i napredak ovde mogu biti resetovani.

column1: Community server, unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Vostok Games. Survarium is a trademark of its owners.
column2: Nezvanični server zajednice. Nije povezan sa kompanijom Vostok Games niti ga ona podržava. Survarium je zaštitni znak svojih vlasnika.

column1: Start Skhid.bat again. Still failing? Run Skhid-without-updater.bat: it downloads the game and its updates without the launcher, then starts it.
column2: Ponovo pokrenite Skhid.bat. I dalje ne radi? Pokrenite Skhid-without-updater.bat: preuzima igru i njena ažuriranja bez pokretača, a zatim je pokreće.

column1: Your provider blocks our server. The launcher has already switched to our relay, a way around the block (Relay: auto, bottom left). Just press Retry.
column2: Vaš provajder blokira naš server. Pokretač se već sam prebacio na naš relej, koji zaobilazi blokadu (Relay: auto, dole levo). Samo pritisnite Pokušaj ponovo.

column1: Run Skhid-collect-logs.cmd and send the zip it makes to us on Discord: discord.gg/QUmJg3gBhg.
column2: Pokrenite Skhid-collect-logs.cmd i pošaljite nam zip koji napravi na Discordu: discord.gg/QUmJg3gBhg.

column1: The download link is coming soon.
Chrome or your antivirus refuses the download? Try this script: {script}. It downloads the whole game into a Survarium folder beside it.
column2: Chrome ili antivirus ne dozvoljava preuzimanje? Probajte ovu skriptu: {script}. Preuzima celu igru u folder Survarium pored sebe.

column1: Get the original Survarium 0.26g (build 2777) and unpack it.
column2: Nabavite originalni Survarium 0.26g (build 2777) i raspakujte ga.

column1: The server is down for maintenance.
The game closes in {minutes} min; Play is locked in the last 30.
column2: Igra se zatvara za {minutes} min; u poslednjih 30 min „Igraj“ je zaključano.

column1: New registrations are closed for now. Existing players can sign in and play.
column2: Nove registracije su zasad zatvorene. Postojeći igrači mogu da se prijave i igraju.

column1: Run Skhid.bat and press PLAY. The first start downloads the game.
column2: Pokrenite Skhid.bat i pritisnite PLAY. Prvo pokretanje preuzima igru.

column1:
Windows warns about an unknown publisher? Let it run.
Linux: bash Skhid.sh launcher, see LINUX.txt.
column2:
Windows upozorava na nepoznatog izdavača? Dozvolite pokretanje.
Linux: bash Skhid.sh launcher, pogledajte LINUX.txt.

column1:

column2:

column1: Skhid (Ukrainian for “east”) is a community server that lets the Survarium {version} client sign in, trade, form squads and play matches again.
column2: Skhid (ukrajinski „istok“) je server zajednice na kom klijent Survarium {version} ponovo može da se prijavi, trguje, okuplja odrede i igra mečeve.

column1: It has bugs and may not work fully. Your progress, items and accounts can be lost or reset at any time, and the server may be stopped at any time. By playing you accept this.
column2: Ima grešaka i možda neće raditi u potpunosti. Vaš napredak, predmeti i nalozi mogu biti izgubljeni ili resetovani u bilo kom trenutku, a server može biti zaustavljen u bilo kom trenutku. Igranjem to prihvatate.

column1: Download our files and unpack them into an empty folder (e.g. D:\\Survarium). You do this only once.
column2: Preuzmite naše datoteke i raspakujte ih u prazan folder (npr. D:\\Survarium). Ovo radite samo jednom.

column1: Download our files and unpack them into the game's folder, the one with the game folder, replacing files. You do this only once.
column2: Preuzmite naše datoteke i raspakujte ih u folder igre, onaj sa folderom game, uz zamenu datoteka. Ovo radite samo jednom.

column1: Download our files and unpack them over the game's game folder.
column2: Preuzmite naše datoteke i raspakujte ih preko foldera game igre.

column1: Sign in with any name and password: a new name registers itself. Remember the password.
column2: Prijavite se bilo kojim imenom i lozinkom: novo ime se samo registruje. Zapamtite lozinku.

column1: New accounts are refused for now.
column2: Novi nalozi se zasad ne primaju.

column1: Shown once the token is right.
column2: Prikazuje se kada je token ispravan.

column1: User name, or an address or range (1.2.3.4, 1.2.3.0/24)
Also ban the address it last signed in from
column2: Blokiraj i adresu sa koje se poslednji put prijavio

column1: User name, or an address or range
Also lift the ban of its last address
Existing players keep signing in and playing either way. Registration is open by default; a restart goes back to that (or to SRP_REGISTRATION=closed).
column2: Postojeći igrači se u svakom slučaju i dalje prijavljuju i igraju. Registracija je podrazumevano otvorena; restart je vraća na to (ili na SRP_REGISTRATION=closed).

column1: Players see the minutes left from 60 on, cannot press Play from 30, and the game closes at 0. Restarting srp cancels it.
column2: Igrači vide preostale minute od 60, od 30 ne mogu da pritisnu „Igraj“, a na 0 igra se zatvara. Restart srp-a to otkazuje.

column1: Empty fields change nothing. An open game is sent the account again.
column2: Prazna polja ništa ne menjaju. Otvorena igra ponovo dobija nalog.

column1: Item: its id in the 0.26g dictionary, or its exact name
column2: Predmet: njegov id u rečniku 0.26g ili tačan naziv

column1: Count (rounds for ammo; up to 8 of anything else)
column2: Količina (meci za municiju; do 8 za sve ostalo)

column1: Everyone in the lobby sees it, and whoever signs in, until it is cleared or srp restarts.
column2: Vide ga svi u lobiju i svako ko se prijavi, dok se ne ukloni ili se srp ne restartuje.

column1: Maintenance has started: the game closes for everyone who signs in.
column2: Održavanje je počelo: igra se zatvara svakome ko se prijavi.

column1: Hours: a whole number up to {MAX_BAN_HOURS}, or empty for good.
column2: Sati: ceo broj do {MAX_BAN_HOURS} ili prazno za zauvek.

column1: The database was busy: srp's saver writes it within seconds (the history below is shown next time).
column2: Baza podataka je bila zauzeta: srp će to upisati za nekoliko sekundi (istorija ispod biće prikazana sledeći put).

column1: Error: the change stands in memory only: the database refused it ({error}). srp retries the write; check its log.
column2: Greška: izmena je samo u memoriji: baza podataka ju je odbila ({error}). srp ponavlja upis; proverite njegov log.

column1: More than one account has that character name: type its user name or #id.
column2: To ime lika ima više od jednog naloga: unesite korisničko ime ili #id.

column1: Silver is a whole number, + or -, or empty.
column2: Srebro je ceo broj, + ili -, ili prazno.

column1: Type the silver to add (+) or take (-). The balance is below.
column2: Unesite srebro za dodavanje (+) ili oduzimanje (-). Stanje je ispod.

column1: Nothing would change: the account has none of it left to take.
column2: Ništa se ne bi promenilo: nalog više nema ništa za oduzimanje.

column1: A reason is required: nothing was changed.
column2: Razlog je obavezan: ništa nije promenjeno.

column1: The account changed since the preview, or the fields did: nothing was changed. Check the new preview below and apply again.
column2: Nalog ili polja su se promenili od pregleda: ništa nije promenjeno. Proverite novi pregled ispod i primenite ponovo.

column1: Check the change below; type a reason to apply it.
column2: Proverite izmenu ispod; unesite razlog da biste je primenili.

column1: Check the change below, then press Apply. Nothing is changed until then.
column2: Proverite izmenu ispod, zatim pritisnite „Primeni“. Do tada se ništa ne menja.

column1: Type the account: its user name, its character name, or #id.
column2: Unesite nalog: korisničko ime, ime lika ili #id.

column1: Units are a whole number above 0, or empty for all of it.
column2: Jedinice su ceo broj veći od 0 ili prazno za sve.

column1: Tick the items to take (and the units of a stack, or all of it), type a reason, then press Preview.
column2: Označite predmete za oduzimanje (i broj jedinica gomile ili celu), unesite razlog, zatim pritisnite „Pregledaj“.

column1: The items or the choice changed since the preview: nothing was changed. Check the new preview below and apply again.
column2: Predmeti ili izbor su se promenili od pregleda: ništa nije promenjeno. Proverite novi pregled ispod i primenite ponovo.

column1: Check what would be taken below; type a reason to apply it.
column2: Proverite ispod šta bi bilo oduzeto; unesite razlog da biste primenili.

column1: Check what would be taken below, then press Apply. Nothing is changed until then.
column2: Proverite ispod šta bi bilo oduzeto, zatim pritisnite „Primeni“. Do tada se ništa ne menja.

column1: A reason is required: the player is told it.
column2: Razlog je obavezan: igrač će ga videti.

column1: Account: user name or character name
column2: Nalog: korisničko ime ili ime lika

column1: Nobody gets its chat lines, on any channel; it gets "muted for <reason>" (or "muted until <time> UTC: <reason>") back instead. Unmute needs the account only.
column2: Niko ne dobija njegove poruke, ni na jednom kanalu; umesto toga on dobija nazad "muted for <razlog>" (ili "muted until <vreme> UTC: <razlog>"). Za uklanjanje utišavanja dovoljan je nalog.

column1: This preview was used already or is older than 10 minutes: nothing was changed. Check the new preview below and apply again.
column2: Ovaj pregled je već iskorišćen ili je stariji od 10 minuta: ništa nije promenjeno. Proverite novi pregled ispod i primenite ponovo.

column1: The account has no item {item_id} now (sold or taken meanwhile): nothing was changed. Check the list again.
column2: Nalog sada nema predmet {item_id} (u međuvremenu prodat ili oduzet): ništa nije promenjeno. Ponovo proverite spisak.

column1: 0 units of item {item_id}: leave it empty for all of it.
column2: 0 jedinica predmeta {item_id}: ostavite prazno za sve.

column1: yes: its game is sent the change at once
no: it sees the change at its next sign-in
column2: ne: izmenu će videti pri sledećoj prijavi

column1: Account: user name, character name or #id
column2: Nalog: korisničko ime, ime lika ili #id

column1: Preview shows the balance before and after; nothing changes until Apply. A balance never goes below 0. An open game shows the change at once.
column2: Pregled prikazuje stanje pre i posle; ništa se ne menja do „Primeni“. Stanje nikad ne pada ispod 0. Otvorena igra odmah prikazuje izmenu.

column1: Tick what to take. A stack takes the units typed, or all of it when empty. Kit * is the one it plays.
column2: Označite šta oduzeti. Iz gomile se oduzima uneti broj jedinica ili cela gomila ako je prazno. Komplet * je onaj kojim igra.

column1: First the list, then a preview of what is taken; nothing changes until Apply. A worn item is taken off every kit, as when it is sold. An open game shows the change at once.
column2: Prvo spisak, zatim pregled onoga što se oduzima; ništa se ne menja do „Primeni“. Nošeni predmet se skida sa svih kompleta, kao pri prodaji. Otvorena igra odmah prikazuje izmenu.

column1: An item rolls up to three modifiers, each of a different kind. The stronger, the rarer.
column2: Predmet dobija do tri modifikatora, svaki druge vrste. Što jači, to ređi.
Ovi se nikad ne dobijaju nasumično.

column1: No account signs in with that user name (character names are not looked up).
column2: Nijedan nalog se ne prijavljuje tim korisničkim imenom (imena likova se ne pretražuju).

column1: Type the user name the player signs in with.
column2: Unesite korisničko ime kojim se igrač prijavljuje.

column1: Check the account below, then press the reset button.
column2: Proverite nalog ispod, zatim pritisnite dugme za resetovanje.

column1: That user name now means another account: nothing was changed. Check it below.
column2: To korisničko ime sada označava drugi nalog: ništa nije promenjeno. Proverite ga ispod.

column1: The password of {login} is cleared; {ended} session(s) ended. Their next sign-in, with any password, sets the new one.
column2: Lozinka naloga {login} je obrisana; završene sesije: {ended}. Sledeća prijava, sa bilo kojom lozinkom, postavlja novu.

column1: The password of {login} is cleared; {ended} session(s) ended. The database was busy: srp's saver writes it within seconds. Their next sign-in, with any password, sets the new one.
column2: Lozinka naloga {login} je obrisana; završene sesije: {ended}. Baza podataka je bila zauzeta: srp će to upisati za nekoliko sekundi. Sledeća prijava, sa bilo kojom lozinkom, postavlja novu.

column1: Error: the password of {login} is cleared and {ended} session(s) ended, but only in memory: the database was not written ({error}). srp retries the write; check its log before the player signs in.
column2: Greška: lozinka naloga {login} je obrisana i završene sesije: {ended}, ali samo u memoriji: baza podataka nije upisana ({error}). srp ponavlja upis; proverite njegov log pre nego što se igrač prijavi.

column1: yes: its game is signed out
User name the player signs in with (not the character name)
column2: Korisničko ime kojim se igrač prijavljuje (ne ime lika)

column1: Clears the password: the player's next sign-in, with any password, sets it as the new one (owner's decision, 2026-10-18). Whoever signs in first takes it, so reset when the player is ready to sign in. A game signed in with the account is signed out. Case does not matter.
column2: Briše lozinku: sledeća prijava igrača, sa bilo kojom lozinkom, postavlja je kao novu (odluka vlasnika, 2026-10-18). Ko se prvi prijavi, taj je postavlja, pa resetujte kada je igrač spreman da se prijavi. Igra prijavljena ovim nalogom se odjavljuje. Velika i mala slova nisu bitna.

column1: Invalid nickname: at least 3 characters, at most 63 UTF-8 bytes, no spaces or control characters.
column2: Neispravan nadimak: najmanje 3 znaka, najviše 63 bajta UTF-8, bez razmaka i kontrolnih znakova.

column1: That nickname or a Cyrillic/Latin lookalike is already taken.
column2: Taj nadimak ili njegov ćirilični/latinični dvojnik je već zauzet.

column1: Changes the nickname immediately, free of charge. Login and progress stay the same. Duplicate and Cyrillic/Latin lookalike names are refused.
column2: Menja nadimak odmah i besplatno. Prijava i napredak ostaju isti. Duplikati i ćirilični/latinični dvojnici se odbijaju.

column1: That account has not signed in to the 0.26g lobby yet: it has nothing to change.
column2: Taj nalog se još nije prijavio u lobi 0.26g: nema šta da se menja.

column1: Experience and reputation are whole numbers, + or -; the level is 0 to {MAX_LEVEL}; the faction is 1 to 4.
column2: Iskustvo i ugled su celi brojevi, + ili -; nivo je od 0 do {MAX_LEVEL}; frakcija od 1 do 4.

column1: That level is under the skill points the account has spent; reset its skills in the game first.
column2: Taj nivo je ispod potrošenih poena veština; prvo resetujte veštine u igri.

column1: No such item in the 0.26g dictionary (give its id or its exact name).
column2: Nema takvog predmeta u rečniku 0.26g (navedite id ili tačan naziv).

column1: The count for this item is 1 to {most}.
column2: Količina za ovaj predmet je od 1 do {most}.

column1: Each line is at most {MAX_TEXT_LEN} bytes (a Cyrillic letter is 2) with no control characters.
column2: Svaki red ima najviše {MAX_TEXT_LEN} bajtova (ćirilično slovo su 2), bez kontrolnih znakova.

column1: The text is shown to everyone in the lobby, and to who signs in, until cleared.
column2: Tekst vide svi u lobiju i oni koji se prijave, dok se ne ukloni.

column1: Browse weapons, compare base stats and explore their damage and handling.
column2: Pregledajte oružje, uporedite osnovne osobine i istražite štetu i rukovanje.

column1: Recoil and spread of any weapon: aim, stance, skills, gear and injuries.
column2: Trzaj i rasipanje bilo kog oružja: nišanjenje, stav, veštine, oprema i povrede.

column1: Every armour piece: protection, weight, built-in bonuses and what it can roll.
column2: Svaki komad opreme: zaštita, težina, ugrađeni bonusi i šta može da dobije.

column1: Every modifier, its strengths and the items that can get it.
column2: Svaki modifikator, njegove jačine i predmeti koji ga mogu dobiti.

column1: Levels and the experience they take; every skill tree: thresholds, ranks and what each rank gives.
column2: Nivoi i iskustvo koje traže; svako stablo veština: pragovi, rangovi i šta daje svaki rang.

column1: Every faction quest: its goal at each reputation level and what it pays.
column2: Svaki zadatak frakcije: cilj na svakom nivou ugleda i nagrada.

column1: Shots to kill a target in any armour, at any distance.
column2: Koliko pogodaka treba da se ubije meta u bilo kom oklopu, na bilo kojoj udaljenosti.

column1: Spawns, batteries, chargers, containers and artefacts on every map.
column2: Mesta pojavljivanja, baterije, punjači, kontejneri i artefakti na svakoj mapi.

column1: {text} is not an item id: nothing was changed.
column2: {text} nije id predmeta: ništa nije promenjeno.

column1: Experience gives levels, and every level gives one skill point.
column2: Iskustvo donosi nivoe, a svaki nivo donosi jedan poen veština.

Busy, try again in a minute

column1: Every mode: its rules, numbers and maps.
column2: Svaki režim: pravila, brojevi i mape.

column2: Nosite ih do kontejnera svog tima.
